notes.title: Still updating + bugfix list 🙃
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051480/3d5b31e85cfc8a3eab3bd9282889a0e6474ef7a0.png[/img]

Hello, our dear players, we bring you a lot of good news! Our coders have done a lot of work and almost finished fixing bugs. Our entire team hopes that now no one and nothing will stop you ❤️

[h2][b]What you need to do to play the bug free version:[/b][/h2]
1. Delete old saves in ideal situation.
[i]*For those who have only played the release version, we tell you why you need to do this. We have been reworking the save system to make them work correctly. Old saves may conflict with new ones 😭[/i]
2. Update the build to the latest version on Steam.
3. Enjoy the game 😘

[b]We'll also write down what we've managed to fix in the meantime. If you found some bug you had, we've got a match! No joke, we just fixed it. Watch:[/b]

[h3][b]1) Fixed the battle system:[/b][/h3]
- Fixed a bug that made enemies become unresponsive.
- Fixed the state of opponents when you restart the battle.
- Fixed the bug of fighting with Cormac.

[h3][b]2) Fixed save system:[/b][/h3]
- Added a new save system with the ability to migrate old saves.
- Fixed difficulty save.
- Fixed save of messages.

[h3][b]3) Spells and Skills:[/b][/h3]
- Fixed “Stun” spell.
- Fixed “Stun” skill and added visual effects.
- Fixed the spell Vampirism (display, localization, and functionality).

[h3][b]4) User Interface:[/b][/h3]
- Added the option to exit to settings from the pause menu.
- Fixed display of quest rewards.
- Fixed display of enemy moves.
- Added automatic content customization for widescreens.

[h3][b]5) Dice and related mechanics:[/b][/h3]
- Updated the dice throw system.
- Fixed bugs with upgrating dice and worldviews.
- Fixed functional and visualization of dice edges.

[h3][b]6) Notification system:[/b][/h3]
- Added event notifications (new messages, tournaments, quests).
- Notifications of newspapers have been linked.

[h3][b]Extras:[/b][/h3]
- Added new newspaper sprites.
- Changed quest rewards (dice, spells, money, mana, mounts).

[i]We are very sorry to learn that you had problems on release of this game. We sincerely apologize to those players who lost progress. We are trying to get rehabilitated in your eyes, fix the game and will continue to do so. If you notice anything in the game, you can always write in the discussions on Steam or Discord.[/i]

[h3][b]💚 We really hope you will give a second chance to our game. Thank you to those players who support us no matter what 💚[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3016920/Awaken_Hentai_Dice

[h3][b]Hello, guys! We have a serious and frank conversation for you 😘[/b][/h3]

The release of Awaken: Hentai Dice has finally happened. So we're excited to tell you about the upcoming events! First of all we want to apologize to the guys who have bugs during the playthrough.
